text:
maria.g: Quick sync — planning to roll out a client-side header gate for the new embeddings cache behavior. want to confirm canary audience, fallback, and QA checklist.

tom.k: Sounds good. what's the gating header name and how do we decide min client versions? :eyes:

maria.g: header: `X-RW-Client-Gates: embeddings_cache_v2=on`
we'll only set it from SDK v1.4.0+ to avoid old clients choking.

sasha: For canary: start with 5% of active SDKs, but scoped to mobile-app and web-v2 only. Not rolling to old mobile yet.

maria.g: yep. canary cohorts: mobile-v2, web-v2, internal beta flag users. we should exclude enterprise customers on dedicated infra.

kevin.p: Guardrails: if response latency increases >20% for 5m window, auto-disable gate at edge and open a rollout ticket. Also emit `gate_evaluated` telemetry with reason.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: conf-service change at 2026-03-18T02:00Z. Will create canary toggle object `embeddings_cache_v2` with rollout=5% -> region=global -> cohort_labels=["mobile-v2","web-v2","internal-beta"].

maria.g: QA checklist for SDK team:
- add header parsing + safe ignore for unknown gates
- unit tests for header precedence (explicit header > persisted client prefs)
- e2e with fallback path for older server responses
- instrumentation for latency/cold-starts and failure counts

tom.k: Example header handling in JS SDK (pseudo):
```js
// read header, but don't throw if unknown
const gatesHeader = getHeader('X-RW-Client-Gates') || '';
const gates = parseGates(gatesHeader); // { embeddings_cache_v2: 'on' }
if (gates.embeddings_cache_v2 === 'on' && clientVersion >= '1.4.0') {
  enableEmbeddingsCacheV2();
} else {
  // fallback to v1 behavior
}
```

sasha: important: ensure server returns an explicit `X-RW-Gate-Applied: embeddings_cache_v2` when gate is active so we can correlate on the backend logs.

maria.g: yep — we'll add that. telemetry event names: `client_gate.check` (with fields gate_name, client_version, cohort, decision) and `client_gate.toggle` when we flip server-side.

kevin.p: Also add a safety timeout: if the new cache path doesn't return within 100ms for first token, fallback to v1 path for that request and increment `gate_fast_fallback` metric.

tom.k: Do we need a migration plan for persisted client prefs? older SDKs might store gate flags in local storage.

maria.g: strategy: only newer SDKs (>=1.4.0) will honor persisted prefs. older ones ignore header and storage both. that reduces risk. note this in release notes.

sasha: ops playbook snippet for rollback:
- set conf-service `embeddings_cache_v2` rollout=0%
- revoke header in SDK dynamic config (if needed)
- create incident channel with prefix `incident/emb-cache-v2`

maria.g: final asks before I open the rollout PR:
1) sdk team confirm header parsing + tests (tom)
2) infra confirm canary object created (infra-bot confirms)
3) observability add dashboards/alerts (kevin)

tom.k: I'll add tests today and link PR. ping me for code review. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: canary object `embeddings_cache_v2` created (id: gate_9821). rollout=5%, cohorts set.

kevin.p: I'll add a dashboard tile for mean latency by cohort and a 5m alert on 20% regression.

maria.g: thanks all. i'll draft the rollout PR and include the QA checklist and rollback steps. tagging @devex for visibility.

sasha: LGTM

tom.k: ack, will review PR tonight.

kevin.p: ack

maria.g: closing thread, will post PR link once ready. :rocket:
